==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] uncooked brown [[Cookbook:rice|rice]]
* 2–2 ½ cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinches]] sea [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Procedure==
#Wash the rice and soak for a couple of hours or overnight.
#Cook the rice in a [[Cookbook:Pressure Cooking|pressure cooker]] until the liquid is absorbed.
#Grind the cooked rice in a [[Cookbook:Mortar and Pestle|mortar]] until the grain is completely fluid and sticky. This will take at least 30 minutes of grinding when done by hand.
#Shape the mash into 2 cm squares. Place the rice squares on an oiled plate and allow to dry for 1–2 days.
#Keep covered in a cold dry room or in the refrigerator.
#After this, roast the squares for 5 minutes in a pan.

steps.text: Wash the rice and soak for a couple of hours or overnight.
Cook the rice in a pressure cooker until the liquid is absorbed.
Grind the cooked rice in a mortar until the grain is completely fluid and sticky. This will take at least 30 minutes of grinding when done by hand.
Shape the mash into 2 cm squares. Place the rice squares on an oiled plate and allow to dry for 1–2 days.
Keep covered in a cold dry room or in the refrigerator.
After this, roast the squares for 5 minutes in a pan.
